mechanism: AI training and inference demand converts directly into NVIDIA accelerator, networking, interconnect, system and software revenue; platform breadth and rapid product cadence can retain economics as clusters scale, while hyperscaler capex concentration, export controls, custom silicon, supply commitments and valuation constrain shareholder returns.
catalyst: Q2 guidance converts with durable mid-70% gross margins; Rubin ships broadly on schedule; networking and non-hyperscale AI demand continue to scale; or recurring software and enterprise adoption broaden cash-flow sources.
invalidation: Customer AI returns fail to support capex; Data Center growth or margins deteriorate materially; Rubin is delayed or loses adoption; custom silicon or competitors erode platform economics; export controls expand; or supply commitments create material provisions and weak cash conversion.
